newsitem.title: UK: Caird shares gain on newspaper buy tip.
newsitem.headline: Caird shares gain on newspaper buy tip.

text.p: Shares in British waste management company Caird Group Plc were indicated higher ahead of the market opening after being tipped as a buy by the Sunday Times newspaper.

Shares were indicated up 27.5 pence to 785 pence after Paul Kavanagh wrote in the newspaper that the company's rating was cheap, as it traded on 13 times earnings while offering 20 percent year-on-year growth.
"On a 12-month view the shares have good potential upside," Kavanagh said.

He added that the introduction of a tax on landfill last October aimed at encouraging recycling had cut the number of sites approved, which in turn had increased costs of depositing waste and the value of existing sites.
"These ultimately benefit both Caird's profitability and, as important, its net asset value," Kavanagh said.
